06.11.2024 CLCON No. 193 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The present Contempt Petition has 
been filed alleging the willful disobedience 
of an order dated 13.06.2024, passed in 
WPSB No. 278 of 2023.
2. By the said order, the following 
direction was issued, “Petitioner will hand 
over the keys of the locker before an 
officer nominated by the In-charge 
Managing Director, within ten days from 
today and an inventory of articles found 
therein shall be prepared in the presence 
of the petitioner.”
3. Notice has been served on the 
respondent (annexure 2 page 58).
4. There is no representation on behalf 
of the respondent. 
5. Bailable warrant of Rs. 20,000/- is 
issued against the respondent-Praveen 
Tandon.
6. Steps to be taken within three days. 
7. List on 03.12.2024.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)

21.11.2024 CLCON No.193 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
On 06.11.2024, there was no 
representation on behalf of the 
respondent. Therefore, bailable warrant of 
Rs.20,000/- was issued against the 
respondent-Praveen Tandon. 
2. Heard Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned 
counsel for the petitioner and Mr. S.S. 
Yadav, learned counsel for the respondent 
on the Recall Application (IA No.1 of 
2024).
3. In the interest of justice, bailable 
warrant of Rs.20,000/- issued against the 
respondent-Praveen Tandon is hereby 
cancelled. 
4. List on 06.12.2024.
5. The respondent- Praveen Tandon 
is directed to appear in-person before 
this Court on the date fixed.
6. Recall Application (IA No.1 of 2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
